choice.basis: The visual evidence confirms that Rhode Island (RI) is gray, which is not part of the risk gradient legend and thus has no assigned risk value. New Mexico (NM) is dark burgundy-red, indicating the lowest risk (0). Delaware (DE) is orange-red, indicating medium risk. Among the offered options, DE is the only one with a visible, positive risk value, making it the highest-risk state among the available choices consistent with the routing criterion.
choice.option_label: Open Delaware (DE) risk detail for routine monitoring
